task.task_name: Implement separate relay v2 publication and atomic one-time prekey claims with JS-Go fixtures
task.description: Implement an additive Go relay v2 prekey service and HTTP routes that satisfy the independently authored shared-fixture, immutability, permanent OTK reservation, restart, replay, and concurrency tests.
acceptance_criteria: The shared TypeScript/Go relay-v2 fixtures have matching validation outcomes.
Publishing byte-identical raw bundle bytes is idempotent and changing bytes under the same bundle_id returns BUNDLE_ID_CONFLICT.
One-time prekey tuple and public-key reservations remain permanent across expiry, claim, and Badger restart.
Twenty concurrent distinct claim IDs allocate exactly one bundle without data races.
The same claim_id and selector replays the exact stored bytes, while a changed selector returns CLAIM_ID_CONFLICT.
POST /v2/prekeys/publish and POST /v2/prekeys/claim expose stable status/error mappings while all v1 routes remain unchanged.
Tagged relay-v2 race tests, untagged Go tests, protocol tests, and relevant typechecks pass.
task.context: The v2 payload is defined by packages/protocol/src/types/signalPreKeyBundleV2.ts and the reviewed CLI specification. Preserve the exact raw bundle JSON bytes. Validate strict shape, TTL, root-signed DeviceRecord, and device signature over the fixed transcript; native Signal signatures remain a client validation responsibility. Require a non-null OTK. Use one Badger write transaction for publish indexes and one for claim allocation/replay. Keep durable tombstones/indexes. V1 must remain compatible. Repository is unborn main; do not commit.
task.module_patterns: Go service/repository/handler/router layering, Badger transactions, httptest route tests, typed sentinel error codes, strict JSON decoding; ESM TypeScript shared protocol fixtures.

test_case_specs.run_command: cd apps/relay && go test -race -tags=relayv2 ./internal/storage/repository && go test ./...
